name: iBuilder
subtitle: Switch games you own, built on your iPhone
description: The official releases of iBuilder, from github.com/Absenti/iBuilder. The app contains no game, no firmware and no keys: use it only with games you own and keys dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo.

apps.name: iBuilder
apps.subtitle: Switch games, built on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
iBuilder turns a Switch game dump you own into a native iOS build on the iPhone itself: extract, rewrite, translate the shaders, sign and play. Experimental: results differ per game.

No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use it only with your own games and the prod.keys of your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

What the app can do depends on the certificate you install it with: see the README.

versions.localizedDescription:
> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**New**
- **No rebuild after an app update** that does not change what a built game is made of (a new *framework id*: host, rewriter, assembler, signer, profiles, game tables). The first update to 0.1.7 still rebuilds each game once.
- **Beach Buggy Racing 2**: shaders read from Vector Unit's `.apf` archives (0 → 496), and the game no longer quits at start (engine: the friends notification queue opens offline). A game marked "no shader" by an older split is split again automatically.
- **"Not supported yet"** on a game whose build found no shader it can read (Play asks first); **"The game closed itself"** on the next launch when a game calls exit at start, with Share the log.
- Shader preparation progress in the Library's one-game view and the iPad hero.

**Fixes**
- **Exported IPAs rejected by on-device signers** (FlareStore: "Can't get BundleID, BundleVersion, or BundleExecute in Info.plist!"): the exported `Info.plist` used `<true />`, which zsign's plist reader refuses; it is now written as `<true/>` and checked as zsign reads it.

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+, iPhone 12 or later. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 251 checks passed).

> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**New: iPhone 12 and later**
- **GPUs without BC textures** (A14–A16, e.g. iPhone 12–15 non-Pro, A14–A16 iPads) now take the engine path ported from the community fork [mianmuhammadse/nxnative `no-bc`](https://github.com/mianmuhammadse/nxnative/tree/no-bc) (MIT): BC1–5 decoded on the GPU at upload, BC1/2/3 stored as ASTC 4x4 (a quarter of the memory), CPU only for BC6H/BC7/3D. Automatic. `DM_NO_BC_GPU=0` / `DM_NO_BC_ASTC=0` switch back for comparison.
- **Memory-pressure response** on iOS: the engine trims its caches on a system memory warning or low headroom.
- Not yet tested on an A14–A16 device here: reports with logs are welcome.

Requirements: iPhone 12 or later (A14+, Metal 4) or an iPad with A14/M1 or later, iOS/iPadOS 26+.

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 244 checks passed).

> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**New**
- **Choose which game's shaders are prepared**: the Build tab lists the games waiting for shader preparation with their progress. Per game: *Prepare this one now* (the current one pauses and keeps what it finished), *Pause / Resume*, *Skip / Queue again*. The order persists; a newly built game now goes to the end of the queue.

**Fixes**
- **Full IPA export rejected by on-device signers** (FlareStore: "Can't get BundleID, BundleVersion, or BundleExecute in Info.plist!"): `Info.plist` is now written first in the IPA (it sat past 4 GB behind the game's RomFS, a ZIP64 offset many unzippers mishandle). Exports above 4 GB warn and offer the light export; the written IPA is reopened and checked.

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 244 checks passed).

> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**New**
- **Export without a `.p12`**: with no signing certificate in iBuilder, a build is signed ad hoc for export only; export the IPA and install it with your signing tool (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Xcode or a certificate provider re-signs it). The `.p12` is now needed only to play inside iBuilder; importing one later offers "Sign again to play".
- **GPUs without BC textures** (A14–A16 devices, e.g. iPhone 12–15 non-Pro): detected automatically; BC textures are decoded on the CPU. Untested on such devices: expect slow loading and high memory use; reports welcome.

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 240 checks passed).

> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**Fixes**
- The first build of a game now waits for, and includes, its update and DLC (it could start while the update was still downloading)
- A game's settings sheet no longer grows wider than the screen
- The selected tab no longer draws its icon over its label
- NAS listing: updates and DLC are classified and grouped under their game; a base game on the iPhone offers its update from the NAS
- Review fixes (r5): NAS cover reads, free space never read as 0, warm-up wait bounded, discarding a paused rebuild keeps the working build, boot-loop guard on device, stricter no-spawn gate

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 236 checks passed).
First public release. No game, firmware or key included: use only games you own and keys from your own console.
